findings.governingReading: Rin makes Shirou take several kinds of medicine.
findings.explanation: Medicine is incorrectly left as a mass noun after various, obscuring the plurality of remedies.

findings.governingReading: Shirou is stunned or shocked by being told not to return tomorrow.
findings.explanation: Surprised weakens the force that launches his fear that their shared life is ending.

findings.evidenceJa: もうとっくに終わってた
findings.governingReading: Rin says their cooperative relationship had already ended some time ago.
findings.explanation: The English changes the retrospective discovery into a simple present state and omits long since.

findings.governingReading: Rin and Father Kotomine stand in an explicit teacher-student relationship.
findings.explanation: Close replaces the formal instructional relation with unspecified personal intimacy.

findings.highlight: Please give me your best regards
findings.evidenceJa: これからもよろしく頼む
findings.governingReading: Shirou asks Rin to keep working with and looking after them from here on.
findings.explanation: Please give me your best regards is a literalized social formula rather than natural English for continued cooperation.

findings.governingReading: Rin says her own preceding remark was a slip and signals that Shirou must not pursue it.
findings.explanation: The English assigns the slip to Shirou, reversing the speaker responsible for the revealing line.

findings.highlight: It must be upsetting for Saber if you’re like this.
findings.evidenceJa: これじゃセイバーも大変だわ
findings.governingReading: Rin says Saber must have a hard time dealing with Shirou as he is.
findings.explanation: Upsetting makes the consequence an emotional reaction rather than the ongoing burden of handling him.

findings.highlight: that aspect of you is upsetting
findings.evidenceJa: アンタのそういうところが大変
findings.governingReading: Rin says precisely that aspect of Shirou makes things difficult for Saber.
findings.explanation: Upsetting again substitutes hurt feeling for the practical burden created by his obliviousness.

findings.highlight: even now, she just sits there all quiet
findings.governingReading: Shirou recalls Saber silently sitting in formal seiza earlier that morning.
findings.explanation: Even now moves the remembered behavior into the present and generic sitting removes the formal posture.
